Class FieldNames

java.lang.Object
forj.json.spi.FieldNames
public final class FieldNames extends Object
The field names of one shape, encoded once so readers and writers never build a String per field.

A reader matches the raw bytes of a field name with indexOf(byte[], int, int), which doesn't allocate; a writer copies encodedField(int), the name already escaped, quoted and followed by a colon. Indices follow the order the names were given in.
